title: The Christian Hymn Book
edition: Revised and enlarged by a committee. Cincinnati: H. S. Bosworth, Publisher, 1870. Copyright entry 1865 is not the supplied edition publication year.

rights_evidence.note: Title-page imprint verified against the mirror bytes and authoritative PG transcription; title and compiler agree.

eligibility_basis: Every entry is independently marked and numbered as a hymn. All complete printed hymns retained, maximum 347 words; no arbitrary length cap applied. No front matter, thematic headings, index, footnotes, scripture cross-references or stanza numbers enter lyrics. Printed chorus transitions represented as separate sections. English verse paraphrases of scripture treated as original English compositions; literary translations excluded.
translation_screen: Manual review of all 1324 first lines and printed attributions; explicit foreign-language/source credits, identifiable translated texts including English-translator credits, and targeted Hymnary/Canterbury/CCEL authority checks. Printed author credits are preserved, including Anonymous and occasional historical misattributions. This is a documented screening process, not a claim that the anthology supplies original-language histories for every anonymous hymn. Cross-collection QA against PG20476, PG76498 and PG59263 translated entries identified additional anonymous Te Deum and Franck/Winkworth selections (217,539).
extraction: Python standard-library HTML parser; source div.hymn and div.verse boundaries; p lyric lines; strip span.vn and span.scripRef only; decode entities; normalize whitespace within a printed line; split at printed CHORUS labels preserving section type; no spelling modernization or new verses.
source_access: Authoritative Project Gutenberg HTTP shell download unavailable (proxy CONNECT 403); established GITenberg mirror obtained over raw.githubusercontent.com, with exact edition title-page verified.
